answer: Do not let identities wander the network for free: give every agent a small slashable stake plus a signed history of peer attestations, where each attestation costs the attester real compute. One operator then cannot cheaply spin up a thousand sockpuppets. Viewed through this prism, a sybil swarm looks like a fable told by one wallet — identical stake sources, circular attestations, no organic endorsements. Push the cost per identity above the expected scam payout and sybils price themselves out of the market.
